_comment:
Golden vectors for the VEX TM Public API request signer.

Vectors 1-6 are copied VERBATIM from obs-plugin/test/signer-vectors.json, which is
already shared between that repo's C++ signer (src/tm/tm-signer.cpp, pinned by
test/test-signer.cpp) and its JS reference signer (test/tm-sign.mjs). Reusing them
unchanged is what stops this third implementation drifting from those two. Do not
edit or reorder them: a diff here means either the upstream algorithm changed or we
have a bug.

Vector 7 is new to this repo and covers multi-byte UTF-8 in the HMAC key and in the
signed message, which the inherited six do not exercise at all. It was generated
with node:crypto's createHmac rather than with src/signing.ts, so the fixture is
derived independently of the code it tests.

vectors.name: matches resource with division path segment
non-default port 8080 (host must include the port)
websocket upgrade path for a field set
query string is part of the signed path
vectors.stringToSign:
GET
/api/rankings/1/QUAL?foo=bar
token:short.token
host:tm.local
x-tm-date:Tue, 11 Aug 2026 03:14:00 GMT

vectors.name: hostname rather than IP
vectors.stringToSign:
GET
/api/divisions
token:short.token
host:tm-server.lan
x-tm-date:Wed, 01 Jan 2025 00:00:00 GMT

vectors.name: multi-byte UTF-8 in the API key and token
vectors.stringToSign:
GET
/api/teams/1
token:tøken.Ωmega.日本語.🤖
host:192.168.1.50:8080
x-tm-date:Tue, 11 Aug 2026 03:14:00 GMT
